{{Combat}} [[Caer Darrow]] | affiliation = [[Forsaken]], [[Frostwolf clan]], [[Revantusk tribe]], [[Horde]], [[Gilneas (kingdom)|Kingdom of Gilneas]], [[Stromgarde (kingdom)|Kingdom of Stromgarde]], [[Wildhammer clan]], [[Silvermoon Remnant]], [[Alliance]], [[Argent Dawn]], [[Scarlet Crusade]], [[Syndicate]], [[Boulderfist clan]], [[Crushridge]], [[Witherbark tribe]], [[Scourge]] | loc = Northern [[Eastern Kingdoms]] | faffiliation = [[Lordaeron (kingdom)|Remnants of Lordaeron]], [[Burning Legion]], [[Arathor|Empire of Arathor]] }} '''Lordaeron''' is the northernmost continent of the [[Eastern Kingdoms]]. It was named after the [[Lordaeron (kingdom)|city-state of Lordaeron]] by the lords of [[Strom]].[https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/The_Seven_Kingdoms The Seven Kingdoms] Separated from [[Khaz Modan]] by a narrow strait, the continent of Lordaeron stretches from the [[Arathi Highlands]] in the south to the [[Eversong Wastes]] in the far north. Historically, the continent has been populated by [[human]]s in the northern, western and southern regions, [[troll]]s in the eastern regions; the [[Hinterlands]] and [[Zul'Aman]], and [[High elf|high elves]] in the far-northern [[Quel'Thalas]]. The climate of Lordaeron is moderate, although the land is rugged and largely mountainous in and around the [[Hinterlands]], [[Alterac Mountains|Alterac]] and [[Arathi Highlands]]. The southern, northern, and western regions of [[Hillsbrad Foothills|Hillsbrad]], [[Gilneas]], and [[Tirisfal Glades|Tirisfal]] are characterized by mild forests and farmlands whereas the north-eastern region of [[Zul'Aman]] is covered by a thick and wild forest. ==Geography== ===Zones=== * [[Alterac Mountains]] * [[Arathi Highlands]] * [[File:Expansion_logo_mysteriesofazeroth.png|40px]] [[Gilneas]] * [[Hillsbrad Foothills]] * [[Hinterlands|The Hinterlands]] * [[Plaguelands|The Plaguelands]] ** [[Eastern Plaguelands]] ** [[Western Plaguelands]] ** [[File:Expansion_logo_mysteriesofazeroth.png|40px]] [[Scarlet Enclave]] * [[Silverpine Forest]] * [[Tirisfal Glades]] * [[File:Expansion_logo_mysteriesofazeroth.png|40px]] [[Thalassian Highlands]] * [[File:Expansion_logo_mysteriesofazeroth.png|40px]] [[Eversong Wastes]] (NYI) ==Notes and trivia== {{Reflist|group=n}} *The demonym of Lordaeron and the homonymous [[Lordaeron (kingdom)|kingdom]] and [[Capital City|city]] founded upon it is "Lordaeronian"[[The Silverpine Wars]][[The Silverline Raven]] or "Lordaeroni".{{Neutral}} [60] [[The Sword Master]] *After the [[Third War]], the [[Alliance Remnants]] and particularly the [[Blood elf|blood elves]] hid caches of gold, lumber, and artifacts such as magical small buildings all over western Lordaeron.[https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Shards_of_the_Alliance_(WC3_NightElf) Shards of the Alliance (WC3 NightElf)][https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Misconceptions_(WC3_BloodElf) Misconceptions (WC3 BloodElf)] ==Gallery== File:WoWLordaeron.jpg|Map of Lordaeron in the ''Game Manual''.
